title: One name on three or more funded boards
question: Who is listed as an officer, director or key employee of three or more unrelated City-funded organizations in the same year?
finding: 15 rare names appear on the returns of three or more unrelated City-funded organizations in a single year; the organizations behind the top entry received $39.4 million from the City in fiscal 2026.
how: Form 990 Part VII listings, one tax year at a time, counting families of related organizations once. Only rare names are kept, because here the name is the only link.
limits: Serving on several boards is often unpaid. It matters when the organizations compete for the same City money or grant to each other. A shared name across unrelated organizations can still be two people.
